game.name: The Legend of Zelda: Dungeons of Infinity (4:3 Edition)
game.desc: 4:3 layout patch for the PortMaster 1.1.6 VM build. The title, profile menus, and playfield fill the Nova display. HUD panels start hidden; click the right stick to toggle them over the playfield. Select + Start exits. This edition uses its own save folder.
